A pessoa atuará com autonomia na condução de projetos de ponta a ponta, em parceria com a liderança técnica de ML e com as áreas de negócio.ResponsabilidadesInvestigar problemas de negócio e transformá-los em hipóteses testáveis, com desenho experimental e métricas claras de sucesso.Conduzir análises estatísticas e testes de hipóteses, escolhendo entre abordagens paramétricas e não paramétricas de acordo com as características dos dados.Desenvolver, treinar e avaliar modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo fine-tuning de modelos pré-treinados e uso de AutoML para acelerar a experimentação.Construir redes neurais com Keras para problemas de classificação, regressão, séries temporais e representação (embeddings).Projetar e evoluir sistemas de recomendação utilizando redes neurais, Multi-Armed Bandits (MAB) e métodos bayesianos com Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), equilibrando exploração e aproveitamento em cenários reais.Planejar e analisar testes A/B e experimentos online, comunicando resultados com rigor estatístico.Colaborar com engenharia de ML e MLOps no deploy, monitoramento, detecção de drift e retreino dos modelos.Aplicar práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA adotadas pelo time, como Spec-Driven Development (SDD), revisão crítica de código gerado por IA e cumprimento dos critérios de aceite antes do merge.Garantir qualidade, explicabilidade, ausência de vieses e conformidade com a LGPD, com as diretrizes do CNE e com o Referencial do MEC para uso de IA na educação.Apoiar o desenvolvimento de pessoas menos experientes por meio de revisões técnicas e compartilhamento de conhecimento.Comunicar resultados, premissas e limitações dos modelos a públicos técnicos e não técnicos.Requisitos obrigatóriosMais de 3 anos de experiência em ciência de dados, com modelos entregues em produção ou com impacto mensurável no negócio.Sólida base de estatística: inferência, testes de hipóteses paramétricos e não paramétricos, intervalos de confiança e desenho de experimentos.Experiência com modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo validação, seleção de métricas, tuning de hiperparâmetros e AutoML.Experiência prática com redes neurais em Keras e familiaridade com fine-tuning de modelos pré-treinados.Experiência com sistemas de recomendação, incluindo abordagens com redes neurais e Multi-Armed Bandits.Conhecimento de métodos bayesianos e MCMC (por exemplo, com PyMC).Domínio de Python e SQL, e de bibliotecas atuais como pandas, scikit-learn e Keras.Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e noções de MLOps, como rastreamento de experimentos com MLflow ou similar.Experiência com nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP).Boa comunicação e capacidade de traduzir análises em recomendações de negócio.DiferenciaisExperiência em educação, EdTech ou dados acadêmicos.Experiência com séries temporais, NLP ou modelos de linguagem.Experiência com Vertex AI ou plataformas equivalentes de ML gerenciado.Conhecimento de processamento distribuído (Spark) e de bancos de dados analíticos.Experiência com inferência causal e uplift modeling.Mestrado ou doutorado em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Matemática ou área correlata.Requisitos e qualificaçõesEscolaridade: Superior CompletoInformações adicionaisHorário de trabalho:09h às 19h (Seg à Sex) 220hShow moreShow less

title: Senior Applied Data Scientist
description: A little bit about us:We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.You can read more about our company here and about our team and culture here. Also, head to our blog for more news about what we’re building and how we work.About the team:We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack.Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do.We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback.We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals.While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zones in which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up for at least 3 hours per day.Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator.The challengeThe Intelligence Squad is Belvo's AI enabler team. One part of the squad builds the platforms and patterns that let every team at Belvo ship AI. This role sits in the other part: turning the financial data and payments we aggregate across Latin America into models that make real decisions, who looks creditworthy, which transaction is fraudulent, what category a payment belongs to, whether an income statement checks out. That data drives real financial outcomes for the people and businesses on the other end, so the bar for rigor is high.You'll be the data science reference in the squad. We're not hiring someone to execute a modeling backlog someone else wrote. We want someone who decides which problems are worth modeling, defines how we know a model is good enough, and raises the data science bar for everyone they work with. You'll be deep enough in statistics and ML to defend a modeling choice to anyone, whether this is a set of rules to simplify a problem or a complex model that you build. You'll be close enough to the business to turn a commercial problem into a modeling roadmap and a business case. And you'll be a strong enough engineer to take your models from notebook to production and own them there.ResponsibilitiesModel development and selection: Lead the design of statistical and ML models (classification, regression, ranking, NLP or LLM-based) for problems like risk scoring, fraud detection and transaction categorization. Choose approaches on their merits and defend those choices with data, not habit.AI-leveraged delivery: Use agentic coding and research tooling as a core part of how you work: exploring data, generating and testing feature hypotheses, scaffolding pipelines, writing the service around the model. We care about the decisions you ship, not hours at the keyboard, and we expect you to keep compressing the gap between the two.Feature engineering with business context: Work with Product and the business teams to figure out which signals in Belvo's financial data actually explain the outcome you're modeling, and translate an ambiguous business question into a well-scoped modeling problem.Productionization and ownership: Take models past the notebook. Build or shape the pipelines, APIs and services that run them reliably in production, and own them once they're live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and retirement when the evidence says so.Experimentation: Design and run experiments (A/B tests and offline evaluation) to confirm that a model change actually moves the metric it's meant to move.Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with Engineering, Data Research, Product, and the rest of the Intelligence Squad to ship end to end, and with stakeholders across the business to keep your models grounded in what actually matters to them.Business and customer partnership: Work directly with stakeholders and, when needed, customers. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-scoped problems, and explain trade-offs and impact clearly to non-technical audiences, executives included.Staying current: GenAI moves weekly. We expect you to be genuinely plugged in: model releases, papers, and tooling, to hold an opinion on what's real versus hype, and to bring the useful parts back to the squad as a demo, a doc, or a session for our company-wide AI Chapter.Framing the problem: Decide what's worth modeling. Push back when a rule, a heuristic, or a better data pipeline solves the problem without a model, and be willing to kill or retire your own model when the evidence says so.This position may be for you if5+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, or in a similar hands-on modeling role.You've owned models end to end in production, from framing the problem to monitoring it live, and you can point to the measurable business impact they had.You have a solid grounding in statistics and can explain how your models work at that level, not just how to call them.You've built and compared more than one type of model (for example tree-based methods, regression, deep learning) for the same problem and can justify why you picked the one you shipped.You're comfortable in Python for data science (pandas, scikit-learn, and at least one of TensorFlow or PyTorch) and in SQL for pulling and shaping your own data.You've taken several models you built into production yourself, not just handed it off to someone else to deploy.You understand engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, CI/CD, and how to write code someone other than you can maintain.You've built with LLMs past the API-call level: tool use or agents, retrieval, structured outputs, and shipped at least one to production. You can explain how you knew it was good enough, which means you've built some form of evaluation, not just eyeballed outputs.Agentic coding tools are part of your daily workflow, not a novelty. You can walk us through a specific task that used to take you days and now takes hours: how you set it up, what you delegated, and where you still don't trust the output.You're proficient in written and spoken English.Amazing ifYou've worked in fintech, financial risk, or another regulated data environment before.You have a business or strategy background alongside data science (an MBA, consulting, or a product/strategy role).You've worked in a customer-facing data science role, such as a forward-deployed engineer or a solutions/applied team at a data platform company.You've worked with MLOps tooling for model versioning, monitoring, and automated retraining.You've deployed models on AWS (for example SageMaker or an equivalent managed ML service).You've written evals or an LLM-as-judge harness for a non-deterministic system, and have opinions about where that approach breaks.You've used LLMs inside the data pipeline itself: labeling, extraction, categorization, and can say where they beat a classical model and where they quietly don't.Tech stackPython is our primary language for data science and modeling (pandas, scikit-learn, and deep learning frameworks as needed).SQL against a cloud data warehouse for data access and feature work.Claude deployed company-wide and Claude Code for every engineer. Agentic tooling is part of how we work daily, not a side experiment.Cloud infrastructure on AWS, favoring managed services so you can focus on the modeling problem rather than infrastructure plumbing.An experimentation platform for A/B testing and offline evaluation.We use Datadog for service observability across the company.We follow Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery best practices.Our tech stack:We’re building our platform using modern technologies, putting the focus on reliability and long-term maintainabilityWe primarily use Python on the backend. We use battle-tested technologies such as Django, and we are heavy users of Python’s asyncio for some parts of our stackWe use Javascript, Vue.js and Sass on the frontend. We are developing and leveraging our own design system and component libraryWe run our infrastructure on top of Amazon Web Services, leveraging managed services. We tend to favor the use of managed services wherever possible, in order to focus on our business problemsWe observe and monitor our services using DatadogWe follow Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery best practicesOur process steps:At Belvo every hire is so important to us, that we share the decision to hire as a team.People team chatTake-home challengeChallenge presentationTeam fit chatMeet the foundersShow moreShow less

title: Senior Data Scientist
description: We're looking for a talented and passionate Senior Data Scientist to join Wildlife's Marketing Tech team in São Paulo, Brazil.Wildlife is one of the largest mobile gaming companies in the world. A big part of that success is acquiring users more efficiently, and we do this through a mathematical understanding of market and user dynamics. We believe that our models are a core part of our edge, and we're looking for people to push them further.As a Senior Data Scientist, you'll play a key role in sharpening that edge: how to handle data from millions of users more efficiently and effectively, how to better understand the mechanics of dozens of different channels, how to make sure we're operating thousands of campaigns the right way, among many others.You'll be surrounded by exceptionally talented people: data scientists, engineers, and marketers who are among the best in the industry at what they do, in an environment where the bar is high, and learning happens fast.The right person for this position is naturally curious, thrives when left to take initiative on their own, loves solving problems and puzzles, is resilient, and enjoys being in a fast and growing business.Main ChallengesResponsibilitiesThe team is responsible for designing, building, and evolving data-intensive applications. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be part of a cross-functional team, directly contributing to:Directly shape how we deploy millions of dollars in Marketing by modeling player behavior at scale.Continuously improve our performance measurement framework, which includes estimating the causal impact of each campaign and the lifetime value of our users to understand the long-term return on our Marketing investments;Create and improve the tools to optimize our acquisition campaigns;Build the capabilities to run experiments to continuously improve the performance of our creative assets and our Marketing operations;Support the decision-making of our Marketing operations through high-quality data products and well-structured dashboards;Disrupt the status quo by incorporating agentic AI in the day-to-day operations: building agents that monitor, diagnose, and act on our campaigns, and a framework for continuous improvement of our end-to-end ecosystem.What You'll NeedExperience applying appropriate statistical or machine learning techniques in different situations (e.g., causal inference, experimentation design, predictive models, etc)Experience working on designing and developing data-intensive applications in the cloud with technologies such as Spark, SQL, Python, Airflow, etcExperience using AI tools to multiply your output; building agentic workflows is a plusExcellent high-level communication skillsProficiency in written EnglishMore About YouYou are impact-driven and interested in learning more about adjacent disciplines;You like to solve open-ended problems with non-obvious solutions;You are an AI enthusiast, constantly pushing the boundaries of what is possible;You are an excellent teammate and raise the bar for those around you.About WildlifeWildlife is one of the world's leading mobile game developers and publishers. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!Equal OpportunityWildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.Show moreShow less
